item.title: [IGNITE-9739] Critical exception in transaction processing in case we have nodes out of baseline and non-persisted cache

nodeId (382437eb-fd8a-4f92-acd5-d9ea562c8557) causing the error belongs to the node out of baseline.

I found this issue only happens if system property IGNITE_WAL_LOG_TX_RECORDS = true
when we try write to WAL information about transaction.
